verification.note: addons/intelligence/app/idf_backfill.py holds request_idf_backfill (43), mark_idf_terms_stale (59), the after_commit/after_rollback listeners (76-84), run_idf_backfill_pass (323) and idf_backfill_loop (368). indexer.py:30, workers/whisper.py:32 and workers/refine.py:37 import from it, and main.py:374 starts the loop from it. database.py contains check_idf_term_rules (1025), but the module has no event listener. The touch-point list does not name this module.

idf_backfill.py:20 imports Session from sqlalchemy.orm, and lines 76/82 register listeners on that global class. They therefore fire for every session, including the _HomevaultSession sessionmaker created at database.py:1956. The effect is benign: the listeners only act when session.info carries the key, and only mark_idf_terms_stale (line 73) sets it. Still, the claim about scope is accurate.

indexer.py:248-250 defines is_paused(), which returns `not self._pause_event.is_set()`. The only caller is idf_backfill.py:114, so the method exists for the backfill. I could not run git to diff against the base, but no other reference exists.

The shared `index` fixture in test_z_auto_tag_drive_scope.py:139-158 patches app.database._search_engine, app.database._SearchSession and app.dependencies._index_manager (147-151) for every test in the file. tests/idf_doubles.py defines MarkerTokenizer (35) and ExplodingTokenizer (59). tests/idf_backfill_api.py and tests/idf_term_db.py exist as helper modules. test_idf_term_marks.py:17-24 imports private helpers from tests.test_refine_fts_reindex.

tfidf.py:729-743 `_rebuild` contains no logger.info call. A grep for 'Rebuilding corpus IDF', _count_document_frequencies, _load_child_tokenizer and _tokenizer_process under addons/intelligence returns no match. _get_corpus_idf (681-726) keeps its caching and single-flight structure.

specification_compliance: The touch-point deviations TP-1 to TP-5 are confirmed. They concern where the code lives and what it covers. None shows a functional violation of I1-I10.
potential_unspecified_behavior: Session event listeners are process-global and also fire on core-DB sessions. They are inert unless mark_idf_terms_stale sets the session.info key.
